# Your Daily Briefing – Thursday 22 October

Yesterday was a solid effort — 7.1km in 44 minutes with an average heart rate of 166bpm shows you were working hard, and 14,998 steps on top of that is a genuinely active day. The concern is your sleep: 5.8 hours simply isn't enough to absorb that workload properly.

Your HRV tells the story clearly — 86ms sits noticeably below your 98-121ms baseline, and with a stress score of 59, your body is signalling it needs more recovery than training today. Keep any session light — an easy walk or gentle mobility work only. Pushing hard right now would dig a deeper hole.

On nutrition, prioritise hitting that 175g protein today — it's doing critical repair work after yesterday's run. Also add an extra glass of water per hour; elevated stress and hard efforts increase dehydration you may not feel. Early night tonight, non-negotiable.
